name: Sigma Klim
source:
Sigma is the protagonist of Zero Escape: Virtue's Last Reward. He is an ordinary college student who has been abducted and thrown into the Nonary Game. Sigma is a generally kind, honest young man, although he can be a little inappropriate at times. He’s easily swayed by his emotions, which makes him a poor choice for a game about trust and betrayal.

[Edited from [url=http://zeroescape.wikia.com/wiki/Sigma]Zero Escape Wiki[/url]]
